purpose: Game decision audit only, not wildfire prediction or human play validation
matched: Same incident/location/weather seed, visible-pressure crew priority and upgrade preference
legacy_triage: Existing size > 0.95 scouting rule, then water when forecast upper bound > 1.1
no_scouting: Always use visible upper bound; never buy scouting
decision_scouting: Buy scouting only when forecast bounds straddle 1.1 and at least five supplies remain; then use revealed forecast
free_perfect_fuel: Unattainable free information control: every burning fire has known fuel before decisions
primary: Paired final reserve difference versus no_scouting
limits: No physical rule changes, fitting, quantum states, hardware, scientific test access or automatic policy tuning. All four policies are fixed before new seeds run.
